items.headline: Mike Johnson won't seek to keep leading House Republicans
items.summary: House Speaker Mike Johnson said he will not seek reelection as the House Republicans' leader after the party's heavy midterm losses. The decision follows an election that handed Democrats control of the chamber.

items.headline: Colom holds razor-thin lead in Mississippi Senate count
items.summary: Democrat Scott Colom leads Republican Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith by a razor-thin margin as Mississippi's Senate race remains too close to call. It is one of two Senate contests still undecided after Tuesday's vote.

items.headline: Iran hails U.S. vote as rejection of war; Vance blames war for GOP losses
items.summary: Iranian leaders said the midterm results showed Americans rejected the war with Iran, as frustration over fuel and goods prices helped Democrats win Congress. Vice President JD Vance blamed the war for Republican losses, appearing to distance himself from the results.

items.headline: Democrats take the Texas House and more state governments
items.summary: Democrats won control of the Texas House and full control of more state governments across battleground and Republican-leaning states. They also won a majority of governorships for the first time in two decades.

items.headline: Trump's arch nears final federal approval as critics seek court block
items.summary: A federal panel is set to consider final approval of President Trump's planned arch on Thursday, and the government said construction could begin the same day. Critics are asking a judge to intervene.

items.headline: Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong sentenced to 10 years
items.summary: Pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong was sentenced to 10 years in prison. It was his second conviction under the national security law imposed by Beijing.

items.headline: Israel's president starts talks on forming a new government
items.summary: Israeli President Isaac Herzog accepted the certified results of last week's parliamentary election. He began consultations on who will form the next government.

items.headline: Super El Niño expected to worsen global hunger
items.summary: A strong El Niño nearing its peak is deepening drought in vulnerable regions. Yale e360 reports it could leave millions more people without enough food.

items.headline: New Congress unlikely to bring quick relief at the pump
items.summary: A Democratic majority in Congress may press the president on the Iran war, but gasoline and diesel prices depend on a complex global oil market. NPR reports drivers should not expect fast relief.

items.headline: NASA's Swift observatory falls back to Earth
items.summary: NASA's Swift space telescope re-entered Earth's atmosphere after a mission that lasted 11 times longer than planned. The re-entry came less than three months after a long-shot rescue mission failed.

digest.overview:
Democrats are set to hold at least 54 Senate seats as counting continues in the last two undecided races. In Mississippi, Democrat Scott Colom led Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith by 1,138 votes, with about 3,600 mail ballots still to count, and in Alaska, Democrat Mary Peltola led Sen. Dan Sullivan by 637 votes, with ranked-choice results due Nov. 18. House Speaker Mike Johnson said he will not seek to remain the Republicans' leader after the party's losses. Vice President JD Vance blamed the Iran war for the defeats. Democrats also won control of the Texas House and full control of more state governments. A federal panel is set to vote Thursday on final approval of President Trump's planned arch, as critics ask a judge to block construction. Investigators began probing a business jet crash in Florida that killed nine, and a shooting at a Tampa-area office complex left two dead, including the suspect.

Abroad, Iranian leaders hailed the U.S. results as a rejection of the war, and Russia launched new drone strikes on Ukraine. Israeli President Isaac Herzog accepted the certified results of last week's election and began consultations on forming a government. In Hong Kong, activist Joshua Wong was sentenced to 10 years in prison on his second conviction under the Beijing-imposed national security law. In Britain, the former Prince Andrew was summoned as a witness in a civil fraud trial, reportedly the first such royal summons in 156 years. Researchers warned that a super El Niño nearing its peak is deepening drought and could leave millions more people short of food.

home.overview:
Victor Wembanyama put up career highs of 52 points and 24 rebounds, with eight blocks, as San Antonio edged Dallas 112–111 on a 14-game NBA night. Philadelphia won 112–106 at Detroit to move to 8-1 atop the East, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 42 in Oklahoma City's 124–116 win over Cleveland, and Klay Thompson's overtime 3-pointer lifted Miami 117–116 at the Clippers. Only two games are on tonight, Orlando at Phoenix and Miami at Golden State. In the NFL, Baltimore turns to undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano against Jacksonville on Thursday night with Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley out, and Cleveland's Deshaun Watson is in the concussion protocol.

Real Madrid won 3–2 at AEK Athens to join PSG on a perfect 12 points in the Champions League, while Liverpool fell 3–2 at Fenerbahçe, Arsenal won 2–1 at Slavia Praha, Manchester City won 3–2 at RB Leipzig and Como routed Lens 9–1. Olympiacos drew 0–0 at Rennes, and the rest of the Europa League and Conference League play tonight. In the Championship, Wrexham stunned leaders Middlesbrough 2–0 as Wolves climbed to second. In the KBO, Samsung beat KT Wiz 3–2 in 12 innings to level the Korean Series at 1–1 before Game 3 in Daegu on Friday.

brief: Samsung beat KT Wiz 3–2 in 12 innings in Game 2 to even the Korean Series at 1–1.
Lewin Diaz had four hits and two RBIs, including a go-ahead single in the 10th, and scored the winning run in the 12th on a KT throwing error, after his own error let KT tie the game.
Samsung starter Chris Paddack allowed one run over seven innings.
The series moves to Daegu for Game 3 on Friday at 6:30 p.m. KST, with Ariel Jurado starting for Samsung against KT's So Hyeong-jun.
